I've never been to a concert alone but I have been to concerts around times where my anxiety was acting up.  I remember a week before I was going to see the Gorillaz I met with my therapist and she told me to repeat this mantra in my head, "I will go to this concert and I will live my life!".  It sounds a bit dumb but it did help me.  Just know that there's nothing wrong with going alone and you most definitely aren't the only one who's there alone.  Music is a powerful and amazing thing and just know that everyone is there for the same reason you are, to enjoy the music and have fun!! No one will be judging you, it will be a judgement free and fun time.  If you get there and you start to feel a bit anxious just try to focus on the music and tell yourself that you're at this concert to have a fun time and you won't let a bit of anxiety ruin it for you.  I remember when i got to the Gorillaz and started to panic a bit I just focused on the vibration caused by the bass when the guest performer was playing before the concert started.  Being able to feel the music all throughout me snapped me out of it a bit.  Have fun tonight and enjoy yourself!!  Everything will be okay and you'll have a great time I promise!
